title: Independent review class
description: governance/ownership/review-classes/<class-key>.yml - an independent approval class; the sole authority for the class-to-principal relationship (T06 #8 d2). No authored enforcement-status scalar exists: actual enforcement is derived and evidenced, never self-declared (GOV-CLASS). One review event or physical identity never satisfies more than one independently required class for a change.

key.description: Stable class key; equals the filename stem exactly.

satisfied_by.description: Non-empty list of principal keys; every referenced principal must resolve in the registry (validator check).
